ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS

OF SAMPLE OFFENCES

3A. Snatching of property.
4. Punishment for taking of property.

THE SAMPLE CODE, 2023
BE it enacted by Parliament as follows:—
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) This Code may be called the Sample Code, 2023.
(2) It shall come into force on such date as notified.
2. Definitions.—In this Code, unless the context otherwise requires, "property" means any movable thing.
Explanation.—A thing attached to the earth is not movable until severed.
1. Subs. by Act 1 of 2024, s. 2, for certain words.
CHAPTER II
OF SAMPLE OFFENCES
3. Taking of property.—Whoever moves property out of another person's possession without consent is said to commit taking.
Illustration.
A moves a pen from B's desk without consent. A commits taking.
3A. Snatching of property.—Taking is snatching if the offender suddenly or quickly seizes the property.
4. Punishment for taking of property.—(1) Whoever commits taking shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years.
(2) Whoever commits taking a second time shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to five years.
